notes.title: Expert mode added
notes.content:
To improve the game's replayability, we were going to add different game modes.  "Expert" mode has been added! It will be available for each completed planet.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30760512/b5fb21d22623212b90f014571f7844d37099752b.png[/img]
